info.title: Jinn operator daemon — read contract
info.description: Generated from operator/src/api/contract/ — never handwritten (spec/2026-08-04-headless-operator-rederivation-design.md §8 artifact 4). Run `tsx scripts/generate-openapi.ts` to regenerate. GET /metrics (Prometheus text exposition, spec §6.2) and the SSE lifecycle tail are referenced here as external profiles, not modeled as paths (spec §6 item 6).

get.summary: Operator daemon status — fleet, balances, activity, rewards, and per-vertical lifecycle rollups.
Server-derived operator notifications — a pure function over receipts + the live-health class (§6.5, issue #2408).
Readiness probe — 200 for reason=ready|degraded, 503 for reason=bootstrapping, unauthenticated (spec §6.1).
